{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data to inspect it thoroughly
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check unique values in the 'channel' column
unique_channels = sales_df['channel'].unique()

# Check if 'revenue' column contains only numeric values
revenue_dtype = sales_df['revenue'].dtype
revenue_sample = sales_df['revenue'].sample(5)

# Print results
print('Missing values:\n', missing_values)
print('\nData types:\n', dtypes)
print('\nUnique channels:\n', unique_channels)
print('\nRevenue dtype:', revenue_dtype)
print('\nSample revenue values:\n', revenue_sample)"}
